summary: Follow Lia from opening Instagram to seeing a Reel, posting one of her own, and getting a like.
scope: An illustrative Instagram-like architecture based on the supplied sketch and Meta’s engineering publications. Meta describes Django at Instagram, ranking funnels, and multi-version video encoding. Service boundaries, caches, queues, and stores in the map are teaching examples.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.api: The gateway is illustrative. Meta documents Python and Django on Instagram’s application servers.
componentNotes.feed: Gather eligible posts for this viewer and return an ordered list of post references.
componentNotes.rank: Meta describes progressively narrower ranking stages. The single block summarizes those stages.
componentNotes.cache: A generic short-lived cache is shown as an illustrative fast path for a recent feed result.
componentNotes.posts: Post records contain metadata and media references. The video itself is delivered separately.
componentNotes.encode: Instagram generates versions for different clients. Meta documents FFmpeg in its video engineering examples and AV1 for selected Reels.
componentNotes.cdn: The edge serves video bytes at a suitable quality. A post remains a separate record.
componentNotes.graph: This store represents durable interactions and relationships such as follows and likes.
componentNotes.queue: An illustrative queue separates writing a like from delivering any notification.
componentNotes.signals: Aggregated activity can inform ranking over time. It is outside the reply path for an individual like.
